6.261 rsInvalidVariableReference
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidVariableReference is a critical error that will occur when an expression refers to a Variable via
the Variables global collection that is not declared in the Report, in the same Group, or in a containing
Group.
